About

Welcome to our website (site) – our domain address is https://www.arborbled.si. This Privacy Policy applies to all content under arborbled.si domain name, including subdomains, folders and subfolders.

Safety of your data is very important to us. We are committed to safeguarding your privacy. Contact us if you have any questions or problems regarding the use of your Personal Data and we will gladly assist you.

By using this site or/and our services, you consent to the Processing of your Personal Data as described in this document.

Table of Contents

  1. Definitions used in this Policy
  2. Data protection principles we follow
  3. What rights do you have
  4. How can Data be gathered together
  5. How we use your Personal Data
  6. What personal data we collect and why
  7. Who else has access to your Personal Data
  8. How we secure your data
  9. Information about cookies
  10. Contact information

[ps2id id=’definitions’ target=”/]

Definitions

Personal Data – any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.
Processing – any operation or set of operations which is performed on Personal Data or on sets of Personal Data.
Data Subject – a natural person whose Personal Data is being Processed.
Child – a natural person under 16 years of age.
We/us (either capitalized or not) – Supervisory Authority representatives as listed here.
Data Breach – a security incident in which sensitive, protected or confidential data is copied, transmitted, viewed, stolen or used by an individual unauthorized to do so.

[ps2id id=’principles’ target=”/]

Data Protection Principles

We promise to follow the following data protection principles:

  • Processing is lawful, fair and transparent. Our Processing activities have lawful grounds. We always consider your rights before Processing Personal Data. We will provide you information regarding Processing upon request.
  • Processing is limited to the purpose. Our Processing activities fit the purpose for which Personal Data was gathered.
  • Processing is done with minimal data. We only gather and Process the minimal amount of Personal Data required for any purpose.
  • Processing is limited with a time period. We will not store your personal data for longer than needed.
  • We will do our best to ensure the accuracy of data.
  • We will do our best to ensure the integrity and confidentiality of data.

[ps2id id=’rights’ target=”/]

Data Subject’s rights

If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

In detail, The Data Subject has the following rights:

  1. Right to information – meaning you have to right to know whether your Personal Data is being processed; what data is gathered, from where it is obtained and why and by whom it is processed.
  2. Right to access – meaning you have the right to access the data collected from/about you. This includes your right to request and obtain a copy of your Personal Data gathered.
  3. Right to rectification – meaning you have the right to request rectification or erasure of your Personal Data that is inaccurate or incomplete.
  4. Right to erasure – meaning in certain circumstances you can request for your Personal Data to be erased from our records.
  5. Right to restrict processing – meaning where certain conditions apply, you have the right to restrict the Processing of your Personal Data.
  6. Right to object to processing – meaning in certain cases you have the right to object to Processing of your Personal Data, for example in the case of direct marketing.
  7. Right to object to automated Processing – meaning you have the right to object to automated Processing, including profiling; and not to be subject to a decision based solely on automated Processing. This right you can exercise whenever there is an outcome of the profiling that produces legal effects concerning or significantly affecting you.
  8. Right to data portability – you have the right to obtain your Personal Data in a machine-readable format or if it is feasible, as a direct transfer from one Processor to another.
  9. Right to lodge a complaint – in the event that we refuse your request under the Rights of Access, we will provide you with a reason as to why. If you are not satisfied with the way your request has been handled please contact us.
  10. Right for the help of supervisory authority– meaning you have the right for the help of a supervisory authority and the right for other legal remedies such as claiming damages.
  11. Right to withdraw consent – you have the right withdraw any given consent for Processing of your Personal Data.

[ps2id id=’how’ target=”/]

How can Data be gathered together

Information you have provided us with

This might be your e-mail address, name, billing address, home address etc. – mainly information that is necessary for delivering you a product/service or to enhance your customer experience with us. We save the information you provide us with in order for you to comment or perform other activities on the website. This information includes, for example, your name and e-mail address.

Information automatically collected about you

This includes information that is automatically stored by cookies and other session tools. For example, your shopping cart information, your IP address, your shopping history (if there is any) etc. This information is used to improve your customer experience. When you use our services or look at the contents of our website, your activities may be logged.

Information from our partners

In general we tend not to, but if we do gather information from third parties, we gather it from our trusted partners with confirmation that they have legal grounds to share that information with us. This is either information you have provided them directly with or that they have gathered about you on other legal grounds. See the list of our partners here.

Publicly available information

In general we tend not to, but we might gather information about you that is publicly available.

[ps2id id=’usage’ target=”/]

How we use your Personal Data

We use your Personal Data on legitimate grounds and/or with your Consent.

In general, we use your Personal Data in order to:

  • provide our service to you. This includes for example registering your account; providing you with other products and services that you have requested; providing you with promotional items at your request and communicating with you in relation to those products and services; communicating and interacting with you; and notifying you of changes to any services.
  • enhance your customer experience;
  • fulfil an obligation under law or contract;

On the grounds of entering into a contract or fulfilling contractual obligations, we Process your Personal Data for the following purposes:

  • to identify you;
  • to provide you a service or to send/offer you a product;
  • to communicate either for sales or invoicing;

On the ground of legitimate interest, we Process your Personal Data for the following purposes:

  • to send you personalized offers* (from us and/or our carefully selected partners);
  • to administer and analyse our client base (purchasing behaviour and history) in order to improve the quality, variety, and availability of products/ services offered/provided;
  • to conduct questionnaires concerning client satisfaction;

As long as you have not informed us otherwise, we consider offering you products/services that are similar or same to your purchasing history/browsing behaviour to be our legitimate interest.

With your consent we Process your Personal Data for the following purposes:

  • to send you newsletters and campaign offers (from us and/or our carefully selected partners);
  • for other purposes we have asked your consent for;

[ps2id id=’what’ target=”/]

What personal data we collect and why we collect it

Comments

When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Contact Forms

We use Contact Forms for one reason and for one reason only – in order for you to get in touch with us. We ask you to populate Name, Email, Subject and Comment for informational purposes, so that we can provide you with the best answer to your inquiry.

Subscription Forms

If you submit a subscription form on our site you will be opting in for us to save your name, email address and other relevant information included in your message. These subscriptions are used to notify you about related content, discounts & other special offers. You can opt our or unsubscribe at any time in the future by clicking link in the bottom of any email.

Cookies

We use anonymous cookies to prevent users from seeing the same popup repetitively in an attempt to make our users experience more pleasant while still delivering time sensitive messaging.

If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you have an account and you log in to this site, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select “Remember Me”, your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

You can read more about our Cookie Notice here.

Embedded content from other websites

Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracing your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Analytics

We use Google Analytics to measure traffic on our website. Google has their own Privacy Policy which you can review here. If you’d like to opt out of tracking by Google Analytics, visit the Google Analytics opt-out page.

[ps2id id=’partners’ target=”/]

Who else can access your Personal Data

We do not share your Personal Data with strangers. Personal Data about you is in some cases provided to our trusted partners in order to either make providing the service to you possible or to enhance your customer experience. However, we do not push data for sharing, but our partners may gather some information on our website throughout their embedded content:

Our processing partners:

  • none

Our business partners:

  • Studio-H – Our web site was built on WordPress technology by Studio-H, Hana Ivančič s.p. Studio-H takes care of the maintenance and security of our site, therefore they have access to related data, which is being used for the administration purposes, only. Please find out more about their Privacy Policy here.

Connected third parties:

  • CleanTalk – WP contact form Ati-spam safeguard widget. They collect information about visitors who comment on Sites that use the CleanTalk anti-spam service. The information they collect depends on how the User sets up CleanTalk for the Site, but typically includes the commenter’s IP address, user agent, referrer, and Site URL (along with other information directly provided by the commenter such as their name, username, email address, and the comment itself).

We only work with parties who are able to ensure adequate level of protection to your Personal Data. We disclose your Personal Data to third parties or public officials when we are legally obliged to do so. We might disclose your Personal Data to third parties if you have consented to it or if there are other legal grounds for it.

How long we retain your data

If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

[ps2id id=’security’ target=”/]

What data breach procedures we have in place

We do our best to keep your Personal Data safe. We use safe protocols for communication and transferring data (such as HTTPS). We monitor our systems for possible vulnerabilities and attacks.

Even though we try our best we cannot guarantee the security of information. However, we promise to notify suitable authorities of data breaches. We will also notify you if there is a threat to your rights or interests. We will do everything we reasonably can to prevent security breaches and to assist authorities should any breaches occur.

If you have an account with us, note that you have to keep your username and password secret.

Children

We do not intend to collect or knowingly collect information from children. We do not target children with our services.

What third parties we receive data from

We might receive third party data (such as IP address for example) from our partners listed here. However, we don’t map their data with ours in order to control user profiles. We use such data only for identifying usability (views and conversion) of clicked targets (linked buttons) on our web site.

What automated decision making and/or profiling we do with user data

We don’t automatically map, control, aggregate nor unify user profiles in any way.

Industry regulatory disclosure requirements

By law, we are obliged to act under EU regulation of GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation). We are not a member of any other regulated industry or a subject to additional privacy laws.

[ps2id id=’cookies’ target=”/]

Cookie Notice

We use cookies and/or similar technologies to analyse customer behaviour, administer the website, track users’ movements, and to collect information about users. This is done in order to personalize and enhance your experience with us.

A cookie is a tiny text file stored on your computer. Cookies store information that is used to help make sites work. Only we can access the cookies created by our website. You can control your cookies at the browser level. Choosing to disable cookies may hinder your use of certain functions.

We use cookies for the following purposes:

  • Necessary cookies – these cookies are required for you to be able to use some important features on our website, such as logging in. These cookies don’t collect any personal information.
  • Functionality First Party cookies – these cookies provide functionality that makes using our service more convenient and makes providing more personalized features possible. For example, they might remember your name and e-mail in comment forms so you don’t have to re-enter this information next time when commenting.
  • Analytics cookies – these cookies are used to track the use and performance of our website and services
  • Advertising cookies – these cookies are used to deliver advertisements that are relevant to you and to your interests. In addition, they are used to limit the number of times you see an advertisement. They are usually placed to the website by advertising networks with the website operator’s permission. These cookies remember that you have visited a website and this information is shared with other organizations such as advertisers. Often targeting or advertising cookies will be linked to site functionality provided by the other organization.

Our web site uses these cookies:

You can fully control cookie settings in your browser. You can opt-out on certain cookies originating from our website here: NASTAVITVE

You can control and remove cookies stored in your computer via your browser settings. More information about settings for specific search engines are available on these links:

Chrome
Firefox
Microsoft Edge
Internet Explorer
Opera 
Safari 

Alternatively, you can control some 3rd party cookies by using a privacy enhancement platform such as optout.aboutads.info or youronlinechoices.com. For more information about cookies, visit allaboutcookies.org.

Note, if you disable all of your cookies, user experience of our site might be affected.

More about cookie Classification

  • First Party Cookies – One of the key attributes of a cookie is its ‘Host’ – this is the domain name of the site that ultimately sets the cookie. Only the host domain can retrieve and read the contents of the cookie once it has been set. If the host name is the same as the domain in the browser address bar when it is set or retrieved, then it is a First Party Cookie. First party cookies are only set or retrieved by the website while you are visiting it, so they cannot normally be used to track activity or pass data from one site to another. However the owner of that website can still collect data through their cookies and use that to change how the website appears to the user, or the information it displays. Of course they can also collect the data and use it outside their website, and even sell it on to other organisations. However, if they do this it must be explained in the site’s privacy policy.
  •  Session Cookie – Session Cookies are only stored temporarily in the browser’s memory, and are destroyed when it is closed down, although they will survive navigating away from the website they came from. If you have to login to a website every time you open your browser and visit it – then it is using a session cookie to store your login credentials. Many websites use session cookies for essential site functions, and to make sure pages are sent to the browser as quickly and efficiently as possible.
  • HTTP Only Cookies – When a cookie has an HTTPOnly attribute set, the browser will prevent any client script in the page (like JavaScript) from accessing the contents of the cookie. This protects it from so-called cross-site-scripting (XSS) attacks, where a malicious script tries to send the content of a cookie to a third party website.

Uvod

Dobrodošli na naši spletni strani (strani) – naš spletni naslov je https://www.arborbled.si. Ta Politika zasebnosti se nanaša na vso vsebino pod domenskim imenom arborbled.si, vključno s pod-domenami, mapami in podmapami.

Varovanje vaše zasebnosti je za nas zelo pomembno. To velja tudi za vaš obisk naše spletne strani. Zato vas želimo seznaniti s postopki obdelave podatkov na naši spletni strani, predstaviti način varovanja podatkov ter pojasniti kdo, kako in zakaj dostopa do vaših podatkov.

V kolikor naletite na težave ali imate vprašanje v zvezi z uporabo vaših osebnih podatkov, nas kontaktirajte in vam bomo z veseljem pomagali.

Z nadaljnjo uporabo naše strani in/ali storitev, se strinjate s procesiranjem nekaterih vaših osebnih podatkov na način, kot ga opisuje ta dokument.

Kazalo

  1. Definicije pojmov
  2. Principi varovanja podatkov
  3. Pravice uporabnika strani v zvezi z osebnimi podatki
  4. Načini zbiranja podatkov
  5. Kako uporabljamo vaše podatke
  6. Katere osebne podatke zbiramo in zakaj
  7. Kdo ima dostop do vaših podatkov
  8. Kako zaščitimo vaše podatke
  9. Politika piškotkov
  10. Kontaktni podatki

[ps2id id=’definitions’ target=”/]

Definicije pojmov

Osebni podatek – vsaka informacija, ki se navezuje na identiteto ali je le-to mogoče določiti na posreden način.
Procesiranje – vsaka operacija ali več zaporednih operacij, ki zadevajo obdelavo osebnih podatkov ali skupka le-teh.
Podatkovni subjekt – oseba, katere osebni podatki se procesirajo.
Otrok – oseba, ki je mlajša od 15 let.
Mi (ali dejanja izražena v prvi osebi ednine) – odgovorna pravna oseba, kot je navedena tukaj.
Odtok podatkov – varnostni spodrsljaj, pri katerem so bili sicer varovani in zaupni podatki odtujeni, kopirani, prenešeni, videni ali uporabljeni iz strani neavtorizirane osebe.

[ps2id id=’principles’ target=”/]

Principi varovanja podatkov

Izjavljamo, da delujemo skladno s temi principi varovanja podatkov:

  • Procesiranje je skladno z zakonom, pravično in transparentno. Pred vsakršnim procesiranjem podatkov se ozremo na pravice uporabnikov. V primeru da uporabnik izrazi željo po pridobitvi njegovih osebnih podatkov, bomo to željo, v kolikor bo le mogoče, upoštevali.
  • Procesiranje podatkov je omejeno glede na namen, za katerega se podatki zbirajo.
  • Procesiranje je izvedeno po principu ‘minimuma’. Zbira in procesira se minimalna količina podatkov, glede na namen.
  • Procesiranje je časovno omejen postopek. Vaših podatkov ne bomo hranili dlje časa, kot je to potrebno.
  • Potrudili se bomo, da bodo zbrani podatki pravilni.
  • Potrudili se bomo zagotoviti integriteto in varnost zbranih podatkov.

[ps2id id=’rights’ target=”/]

Pravice uporabnika strani v zvezi z osebnimi podatki

V kolikor imate na naši strani uporabniški račun ali ste uporabljali komentarje, lahko zahtevate izpis podatkov v obliki datoteke, ki bo vsebovala vse vaše osebne podatke, vključno s tistimi, ki ste nam jih posredovali sami. Prav tako lahko zaprosite za izbris ali spremembo kateregakoli podatka zbranega o vas. Vendar pa ta pravica ne vključuje izbrisa katerega od podatkov, ki smo ga primorani zadržati za administrativne, legalne ali varnostne namene.

Pravice posameznika v zvezi  osebnimi podatki so:

  1. Pravica do informacije – pomeni, da imate pravico do informacije o tem, ali so vaši podatki predmet procesiranja; kateri podatki se zbirajo, kje se pridobivajo in s kakšnim namenom ter kdo jih obdeluje.
  2. Pravica do dostopa – pomeni, da imate pravico do dostopa do podatkov, ki so bili zbrani o vas. To vključuje pravico, da zaprosite in pridobite kopijo podatkov, ki so se o vas zbrali.
  3. Pravica do popravka – pomeni, da imate pravico, da zaprosite za spremembo ali izbris vaših osebnih podatkov, ki so netočni in/ali nepopolni.
  4. Pravica do izbrisa – pomeni, da lahko v določenih okoliščinah zaprosite za izbris vaših osebnih podatkov.
  5. Pravica do omejitve obdelave – pomeni, da lahko v določenih okoliščinah zaprosite za omejeno procesiranje vaših podatkov.
  6. Pravica do zavrnitve obdelave – pomeni, da lahko v določenih okoliščinah zavrnete procesiranje vaših podatkov – na primer v primeru direktnega marketinga.
  7. Pravica do zavrnitve samodejnega procesiranja – pomeni, da imate pravico zavrniti samodejno procesiranje podatkov, predvsem v primeru načrtnega profiliranja.
  8. Pravica do prenosljivosti podatkov – pomeni, da imate pravico pridobiti o vas zbrane podatke v zapisu in formatu, ki je računalniško berljiv in prenosljiv brez oviranja.
  9. Pravica do pritožbe –  v primeru, da zavrnemo vašo prošnjo, ki je navedena pod pravicami o dostopu, bomo pri tem navedli razlog. V kolikor se z našim odgovorom ne boste strinjali ali ga ne boste razumeli, vas pozivamo k nadaljnjemu diskurzu.
  10. Pravica do pomoči – pomeni, da imate pravico do pomoči iz strani odgovorne osebe, pod katero spada tudi pravica do drugih nivojev pravne varnosti.
  11. Pravica do spremembe privolitve – pomeni, da imete pravico do spremembe, če obdelava podatkov temelji na vaši privolitvi, lahko le-to kadarkoli prekličete z učinkom za naprej

[ps2id id=’how’ target=”/]

Načini zbiranja podatkov

Informacije, ki nam jih posredujete sami

To je lahko vaš e-mail naslov, ime, naslov za dostavo, domač naslov, idr. – večinoma gre za informacije, ki so potrebne za uspešno dostavo storitev ali produktov ali zgolj za izboljšanje vaše izkušnje, kot stranka. Iz vaše strani pridobljene podatke shranimo z namenom, da vam jih ne bo potrebno ponovno vpisovati ob naslednjem stiku z našo stranjo.

Samodejno zbrane informacije

Samodejno zbrane informacije vključujejo samodejno shranjene podatke iz strani spletnih piškotkov in drugih sejnih orodij. Takšen primer je uporabnikov IP naslov, informacije v zvezi s nakupovalno košarico,  nakupovalno zgodovino (če le-ta obstaja), idr. Na ta način zbrane informacije služijo bolj prijazni uporabniški izkušnji. Med uporabo naše strani se lahko takšne samodejno zbrane informacije shranijo v tako imenovanih logih.

Informacije zbrane iz strani naših partnerjev

Tega se v splošnem ne poslužujemo, vendar ne izključujemo možnosti, da lahko informacije o vaših podatkih pridobimo iz strani tretjih oseb. V kolikor se to zgodi, bomo informacije pridobili izključno iz strani partnerjev, ki jim zaupamo in bodo potrdili, da imajo so pridobljene podatke pridobili skladno z zakonodajo in jih lahko delijo z nami. To so lahko informacije, ki so jim jih uporabniki naše strani posredovali neposredno ali pa so jih zbrali na drugi pravni podlagi. Lista naših partnerjev je navedena tukaj.

Javno dostopne informacije

Tega se v splošnem ne poslužujemo, vendar ne izključujemo možnosti, da se lahko kateri od vaših osebnih podatkov pridobi iz podatkov, ki so javno dostopni.

[ps2id id=’usage’ target=”/]

Kako in s kakšnim namenom uporabljamo vaše podatke

Vaše osebne podatke uporabljamo skladno z zakonodajo in/ali z vašo privolitvijo.

Vaše osebne podatke v splošnem procesiramo s temi nameni:

  • predstavitev naših storitev, produktov in/ali ponudb. To na primer vključuje registracijo uporabniškega računa; dostavo drugih storitev in produktov, ki so predmet sodelovanja med stranko in nami; predstavitev promocijskega materiala na željo uporabnika; komunikacija in interakcija s strankami; obveščanje strank v zvezi s spremembami naših storitev.
  • izboljšanje vaše uporabniške izkušnje;
  • izpolnjevanje točk iz obligacijskih zakonov in/ali pogodb.

V želji izpolnjevanja pogodbenih obveznosti, vaše podatke procesiramo s temi nameni:

  • osebna identifikacija uporabnika;
  • da bi vas oskrbeli z dogovorjeno storitvijo ali vam poslali oz. ponudili produkt;
  • da bi se dogovorili o podrobnostih sodelovanja ali izdaje računa.

V skladu z legitimnim interesom, vaše podatke procesiramo s temi nameni:

  • pošiljanje osebnih ponudb za naše storitve ali storitve izbranih partnerjev;
  • administrativna uporaba ali analiza baze naših uporabnikov (narava nakupa in zgodovina) v želji, da bi zagotovili boljšo uporabniško izkušnjo, kvaliteto, različnost in dostopnost naših storitev in/ali produktov.
  • za anketiranje strank o zadovoljstvu naših storitev.

V kolikor nismo iz vaše strani drugače obveščeni, smatramo, da so storitve ali produkti, ki ste jih v preteklosti že iskali, naročali in/ali kupovali, v vašem in našem legitimnem interesu.

S potrjeno privolitvijo procesiramo uporabniške osebne podatke s temi nameni:

  • pošiljanje novic in kampanj o naših ali skrbno izbranih partnerskih ponudbah;
  • za druge namene, za katere smo vas prosili za vašo privolitev.

[ps2id id=’what’ target=”/]

Katere osebne podatke zbiramo in zakaj

Kontaktni formularji in povpraševanja

Kontaktne formularje in formularje za povpraševanje uporabljamo zgolj z namenom, da lahko sami stopite v neposreden stik z nami. Prosimo vas, da vpišete podatke v polja, ki so vidna na spletni strani (na primer Ime in Priimek, E-mail, Zadeva, Sporočilo, idr.). Te podatke uporabimo zgolj v informativne namene, da bi vam lahko kar najbolje odgovorili na vaše vprašanje ali povpraševanje o specifični storitvi.

Prijavni obrazci

V kolikor na naši strani izpolnite prijavni obrazec, na primer za prejemanje novic, privolite v shranjevanje vaših osebnih podatkov, ki so predmet obrazca in vašega sporočila. Prav tako se s tem soglasjem samovoljno prijavljate na občasno obveščanje po elektronskem naslovu o ponudbi, ugodnostih, posebnih ponudbah, promocijah, akcijah in drugih aktivnostih iz naše dejavnosti. Svoje soglasje lahko kadarkoli spremenite – povezava do nastavitev, kako in katere vsebine želite prejemati, se nahaja v nogi poslanega e-mail sporočila.

Komentarji

Ko uporabniki pustijo komentarje na naši strani, zbiramo informacije, ki so prikazane v formularju za komentarje, hkrati pa se zberejo podatki o IP naslovu uporabnikove naprave ter iskalniku z namenom identificiranja nezaželene (spam) vsebine. Po privolitvi objave komentarja se javno prikaže vaš komentar, uporabniško ime in vaša fotografija, v kolikor ste jo uredili.

Mediji

V kolikor na našo stran naložite slike, vas prosimo, da se izognete nalaganju formatov, ki lahko vsebujejo vcepljene vsebine (npr. EXIF GPS). Prav tako vas obveščamo, da ste sami odgovorni za uporabno dovoljenje avtorjev in licenčno pravico medijev, ki jih nalagate, zato vas prosimo, da uporabljate zgolj lastne in/ali licenčno odprte medije, za katere ste pridobili ustrezna dovoljenja. Uporabniki strani lahko pridobijo, prenesejo in uporabijo lokalne podatke medijev, ki so objavljeni na strani.

Piškotki

Več o naši Politiki piškotkov si lahko preberete tukaj.

Vcepljena vsebina iz tretjih strani

Vsebina naše strani lahko vsebuje vcepljeno vsebino tretjih strani (npr. video, slike, prispevki, objave, idr.). Vcepljena vsebina tretjih strani se obnaša na enak način, kot če bi uporabnik isto vsebino obiskal na njihovi spletni strani – na prikazovanje teh, nimamo vpliva.

Takšne vcepljene vsebine so zmožne same pridobivati vaše osebne podatke, uporabljati piškotke, vcepiti dodatne vsebine tretjih strani in spremljati vašo interakcijo z vcepljenimi vsebinami.

Spletna analitika

Za potrebe analitike obiska in uporabniške izkušnje uporabljamo spletno orodje Google Analytics. Google ima svojo lastno Politiko zasebnosti, do katere lahko dostopate tukaj. V kolikor želite svoj iskalnik odstraniti iz spremljanja Google Analytics, lahko to storite tukaj: Google Analytics opt-out page.

[ps2id id=’partners’ target=”/]

Kdo ima dostop do vaših podatkov

Zavezani smo k varovanju osebnih podatkov o obiskovalcih naše spletne strani. Osebnih podatkov tretjim osebam ne posredujemo, razen če smo k temu pozvani iz strani uradnih oseb in skladno z zakoni. Tretjim osebam, ki jih smatramo za partnerje, so shranjeni podatki na razpolago samo na način, kot je opisano v tej izjavi.

Vašega IP naslova nikoli ne posredujemo neznancem. V nekaterih primerih do vaših podatkov vendarle dostopajo naši skrbno izbrani partnerji, to pa z namenom, da vam lahko našo dejavnost na spletu sploh predstavimo, hkrati pa zagotovimo boljšo uporabniško izkušnjo naše strani. Kakorkoli, vaših osebnih podatkov sami ne posredujemo tretjim osebam, so jim pa nekateri podatki na razpolago samo na način, kot je opisano v tej izjavi – do vsebin lahko dostopajo preko tako imenovanih vcepljenih vsebin.

Partnerji za procesiranje podatkov:

  • ne sodelujemo

Poslovni partnerji:

  • Studio-H – Naša spletna stran je bila izdelana s tehnologijo WordPress v podjetju Hana Ivančič s.p., Studio-H. V Studio-H skrbijo za varnost in vzdrževanje strani, pri čemer imajo dostop do uporabniških podatkov te strani, ki pa jih uporabljajo izključno za administrativne namene in niso podvrženi drugim procesom obdelave. Več o njihovi politiki zasebnosti lahko preberete tukaj.

Povezane tretje osebe:

  • CleanTalk – je vtičnik, ki skrbi za varnost in anti-spam storitev te spletne strani. Za potrebe opravljanje svoje naloge zbira podatke o vseh uporabnikih, ki želijo uporabiti kontaktne formularje te strani ter identificira naravo njihove uporabe na legitimno in nelegitimno (spam).

Sodelujemo zgolj s tretjimi osebami, ki zagotavljajo visoko raven varnosti vaših in naših podatkov.

Kolikor časa zadržimo vaše podatke

Podatke, ki nam jih sami posredujete, se zadržijo za nedoločen čas – na primer, če na naši strani pustite komentar, se metapodatki vezani naj zadržijo za nedoločen čas. To je z namenom, da lahko morebitne kasnejše komentarje avtomatsko pripišemo vam. Na vašo prošnjo lahko te podatke kadarkoli pobrišemo, spremenimo ali izvozimo.

Ostali podatki, ki se pridobivajo na druge načine, imajo navadno omejen rok trajanja (npr. mesec, dan, čas seje, idr.)

[ps2id id=’security’ target=”/]

Kako zaščitimo vaše podatke

Naredili bomo vse kar je v naši moči, da bomo vaše osebne podatke zaščitili. Za vso komunikacijo, ki poteka na strežnikih, uporabljamo varnostne protokole (kot je HTTPS). Naš sistem redno obnavljamo in posodabljamo. Prav tako imamo implementirane določena varnostna orodja (npr. AntiSpam, FireWall, idr.), ki nam dopuščajo nadzor in spremljanje aktivnosti potencialnih vdorov ter identificiranje šibkih točk sistema.

Kljub temu, da nam je vaša in naša varnost bistvenega pomena, ne moremo garantirati, da do zlonamernega odtoka osebnih podatkov ne bi prišlo. V kolikor se neljubi dogodek vendarle pripeti, bomo o tem obvestili vse odgovorne osebe, ki se jih takšen odliv podatkov tiče. V kolikor bo ogrožena tudi vaša uporabniška identiteta ali pravice, vas bomo o tem prav tako obvestili.

V kolikor imate pri nas odprt uporabniški račun, vas prosimo, da tudi sami poskrbite za varnost podatkov uporabniškega imena in gesla, po končani seji pa se vselej odjavite iz računa.

Otroci

Pri svojem delu namenoma ali z zavedanjem nikoli ne zbiramo informacij o otrokih. Otroci nišo ciljna skušina spletne predstavitve naše dejavnosti.

Tretje osebe, od katerih pridobivamo podatke

Dopuščamo možnost, da sami pridobimo informacije iz strani tretjih oseb (npr. IP naslov naprave), ki so navedene tukaj. Kakorkoli, podatkov pridobljenih pri tretjih osebah ne agregiramo z našimi podatkovnimi bazami (npr. z namenom ustvarjanja uporabniških profilov). Potencialno lahko na tak način pridobljene podatke uporabimo zgolj za analizo uporabe naše spletne strani (npr. število ogledov, konverzija, povezani gumbi, idr.).

Profiliranje in samodejni procesi obdelave podatkov

Pri svojem delu se ne poslužujemo samodejnih procesov obdelave, prav tako zbranih osebnih podatkov ne povezujemo, ne kontroliramo, ne združujemo in ne unificiramo v uporabniške profile.

Pravna varnost

V skladu z zakonom delujemo pod aktom evropske uredbe 2016/679/EU – GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation; Zakon o varstvu osebnih podatkov). Nismo člani nobene druge regulirane industrije ali oseba za katero veljajo dodatni zakonodajni akti.

[ps2id id=’cookies’ target=”/]

Politika spletnih piškotkov

Na svoji strani uporabljamo spletne piškotke, ki nam omogočajo nemoteno delovanje spletne strani ter izboljšano uporabniško izkušnjo.

Piškotki so majhne podatkovne enote, ki nam omogočajo primerjavo novih in predhodnih obiskovalcev, razumevanje, kako uporabljajo našo stran, in ki nam posredujejo podatke, s katerimi lahko naredimo prihodnji obisk spletne strani bolj prijeten in učinkovit. Piškotki ne beležijo nobenih osebnih podatkov o uporabniku in ne shranjujejo informacij, ki bi vas lahko identificirale. Če ne želite, da naša spletna stran uporablja piškotke, zavrnite njihovo uporabo.

Uporabljamo spletne piškotke z naslednjimi nameni:

  • Obvezni piškotki – to so piškotki, ki so nujni za delovanje spletne strani in uporabo njenih možnosti, kot je na primer dostop do varnih območij spletne strani (prijava v uporabniški račun).
  • Funkcionalni domenski piškotki – ti piškotki so uporabljeni za varno, izboljšano in bolj osebno uporabniško izkušnjo. Takšen primer je shranjevanje vašega imena in e-mail naslova, da vam tega ni potrebno vnovično vpisovati ob prihodnjem obisku.
  • Analitični piškotki – to so piškotki, ki se uporabljajo za namene spletne analitike – (npr. sledenje uporabniških navad)
  • Oglaševalski piškotki (tretjih oseb)– ti piškotki se uporabljajo z namenom, da bi se vam predočile kampanje in marketinški material, ki se smatra, da je v vašem interesu. Dodatno ti piškotki preprečijo, da se vam prikazujejo ene in iste oglaševane vsebine. Ti piškotki so navadno na spletno stran vcepljeni iz strani oglaševalskih omrežij, in sicer ob privolitvi ali namestitvi oskrbovalca strani.
